title: Okugezesebwa kw’Omwoyo Ogugumiikiriza
intro: Omwoyo guyimirira mu kaseera ak’okugezesebwa okw’obwakatonda, nga gunoonya obulagirizi n’okugumiikiriza okw’obwetoowaze. Oyo amanyi byonna akyusa omunoonya ono, kyokka n’alaga oluvannyuma nti kino kyali kigezo kya mutima. Okuyita mu kuwaanyisiganya kuno okw’ekyama, essomo erikwata ku magezi ag’obwakatonda libikkulwa mu maaso g’abo abafumiitiriza. Osobola okuzuula omuwendo guno okuva mu nnyiriri za Quran?
clues: Nanoonya okumanya n’obulagirizi okuva eri omubaka wa Allah omwagalwa
Najja nga nnoonya amazima, nga mpita Nabbi n’obwagazi obw’amaanyi
Nanenya ne nkyuka, kubanga amagezi ga Allah gaali galina enteekateeka endala ez’akaseera ako
Naye saaggwaamu ssuubi —mu kifo ky’ekyo, nnagenda mu maaso mu kunoonya kwange
Oyo amanyi byonna yalangirira nti kino kyali kigezo kya mutima era kya kulabula
Nze nali mu abo Quran b’ebikkulako nti: ‘Yafuba ennyindo n’akyuka, kubanga omuzibe w’amaaso we yamujjira’.
